name: Isolated SiC gate driver with DESAT, soft turn-off, Miller clamp and split outputs
function: Drives one SiC MOSFET from a logic PWM across a reinforced isolation barrier with independent turn-on/turn-off resistors, active Miller clamp, DESAT overcurrent detection with configurable blanking, 400 mA soft turn-off, UVLO/RDY and an isolated analog-to-PWM sensing channel.

inputs.name: IN+ / IN-
inputs.description: PWM inputs; cross-wire with the complementary switch for hardware interlock

inputs.name: RST/EN
inputs.description: enable and latched-fault reset (low pulse >= 1000 ns on CGD1700)

inputs.name: VDD / COM / VEE
inputs.description: isolated bias rails referenced to the MOSFET Kelvin source (COM)

inputs.name: DESAT sense
inputs.description: connection to the MOSFET drain through HV blocking diode(s)

inputs.name: AIN
inputs.description: thermistor or divided voltage referenced to COM

outputs.name: GATE
outputs.description: gate drive through RG_ON (OUTH) and RG_OFF (OUTL); clamp via CLMPI

operating_conditions: SiC MOSFETs with Kelvin source up to the IC isolation/working-voltage rating (UCC21710-Q1: 1.5 kVrms working).
Isolated bias capable of Q_G * f_sw * (VDD-VEE) plus quiescent power.
DESAT diodes rated at least the MOSFET blocking voltage (PRD-09301 §5.1).

required_components.source_refdes: R209 or R216 (TI; on/off assignment not resolved from text) / RT27

required_components.value_or_part: 1 x US1Q-TP 1200 V (TI) / 2 x US3M-13 1 kV in series (CGD1700)
VDD - 2.2 k - node - 2.2 k - OC - 220 ohm - COM (CGD1700)
VDD-COM and COM-VEE local ceramics (20 uF each on CGD1700)

design_calculations.name: DESAT trip voltage
design_calculations.expression: V_trip = V_OCTH * (R2 + R3) / R3 - n_diodes * V_F

design_calculations.name: External blanking time
design_calculations.expression: t_blank = -(R1+R2)/(R1+R2+R3) * R3 * C_blank * ln(1 - (R1+R2+R3)/R3 * V_OCTH / VDD)
design_calculations.example: 45.9 ns with R1=R2=2.2 k, R3=220, C=56 pF, VDD=15 V

design_calculations.name: Trip current
design_calculations.expression: I_trip ~ value of I_D where V_DS(I_D, T_J, V_GS) = V_trip on the device output curve

interface_requirements: Isolated bias rails referenced to the MOSFET Kelvin source; never tie the module Kelvin source to the power source in layout (PRD-09301 §1.1).
PWM signal integrity: buffered, RC-filtered single-ended over short distances or differential over cables (PRD-09301 §4).
Controller must generate dead time; interlock is only a last barrier (PRD-09301 §5.6-5.7).
Fault and RDY lines filtered and combined; latched fault cleared by RST/EN.
pcb_constraints: Gate and Kelvin-source routed as wide pours on adjacent layers with Kelvin source shielding the gate (PRD-09301 §2.2-2.3) - KR-PCB-001.
Decoupling capacitors inside the driver-to-device gate loop (PRD-09301 §2.6) - KR-PCB-002.
No copper crossing the driver isolation barrier on any layer; DESAT diodes keep full HV creepage to other net groups (PRD-09301 §2.1, §2.7) - KR-ISO-001/002.
Short DESAT drain connection; route the low-voltage detection side compactly and shielded, long runs only on the HV-diode side (PRD-09301 §6.4).
Gate discharge resistor on the device side of the gate resistor (PRD-09301 §5.9).
validation_notes: DESAT trip/blanking and bias-power formulas recomputed (EC-001..EC-003); CGD1700 DESAT and gate-path connectivity confirmed against the Allegro netlist (EC-022, EC-023, EC-026). Not simulated or hardware-tested by AIPE.
limitations: Resistor, blanking and trip values are instance values; they depend on the device, topology and fault-risk tolerance.
TI's 6.4 V / 1 us DESAT setting was produced with TI's calculator and is not recomputable from the published text alone.
UCC21710-Q1 isolation ratings must be checked against the system's insulation coordination.

alternatives.approach: Long blanking (1 us) with DESAT 6.4 V in a ZVS DAB (TI)
alternatives.trade_off: Fewer false trips with switching noise; longer short-circuit energy before shutdown.

alternatives.approach: Short external blanking (~46 ns + 120 ns deglitch) on a characterisation driver (Wolfspeed)
alternatives.trade_off: Fast protection; higher false-trip risk with ringing - must be measured in circuit.
